title: Unit Event — Live with Memories — Episode5 Delivering Those Words

meta.Event Outline: The wind is in Leo/need's sails as the band continues performing and starts to build its own fanbase. But then, they encounter a brother and sister, who are Leo/need fans, having an argument.

rows.Speaker: Hanano
rows.Line: We have to go our separate ways at some point... And for us, that time might be now...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Even if it's just a little bit...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I want to help relieve them of the pain of being torn away from one another...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(It's like...
These words don't do them justice...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
That was really nice.
You were all in perfect sync and sounded great together.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Thank you.
Also, Miku, thanks for taking Ichika's place.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Ichika still seems to be struggling with the lyrics for your new song...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: She has to spend time writing those lyrics instead of practicing too. Isn't your next show really soon...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, it is...
But things just aren't going that smoothly.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
According to her...
“These words don't do what they're going through justice.”

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hmm... Then, what's the right answer?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Isn't there any way we can help her...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: “These words won't properly shine a light on them not being able to see each other anymore.”

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
I see...
This problem may actually be easier to solve than we think.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Really?!
If so, Luka, you're a genius!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So, Luka, what do you suggest we do?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hehe.
We'll need to talk to Ichika regarding that.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, um... Thanks for asking.
But what about practice?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
We're taking a break right now.
More importantly, you seem to be struggling with these lyrics...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Sorry, I know I am...
But I can't seem to find the right words no matter how many times I try rewriting them.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I was even reminded of how it's hard to listen to what others are saying when you're really down and out...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Um, Ichika...
Mind if I ask you a question?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: What kept you afloat when you felt like everything was sinking?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Remember what it was like not being able to have real conversations with Saki, Honami and Shiho...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: When she had trouble talking to us...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I found myself usually listening to Miku songs...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. I remember you saying that.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wait!
What if one of those songs can give you a nice hint?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: The lyrics were starkly different depending on the genre too. I wouldn't know which to use as a reference...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: In that case, what did you tend to think about while listening to those songs...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Well...
I envied how free Miku seemed... Also...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: If a song sounded cutesy, I'd imagine Saki liking it...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Honami likes delicate and sparkly sounds, so she was really happy playing the wind chimes in the brass band...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Or how it'd be cool to hear Shiho play a song that prominently features a bass and how we'd have to practice so hard to play a song like that together...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm pretty sure that's what usually went through my mind...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hehe.
I knew it. I had a feeling you thought about everyone else.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I... I thought about everyone else too...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thinking about them made me sad since I couldn't see them, but all my fun memories with them just made me want to get better so I could see everyone again as soon as possible...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Did you think of something just now, Ichi?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
What did you think of?!
How did that help just now?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Um... It's what you said, Saki...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: In particular, the part about “fun memories”...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah. We were able to make such fun and happy memories because we were fortunate enough to meet each other...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
That never went away...
And Miku songs always reminded me of that fact.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Not being able to talk to everyone wasn't easy, but all of our happy memories kept me believing that we'd be back together again someday...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah. Our fun memories made what came after just that much harder... But they kept me from giving up...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I... I couldn't do anything even when I remembered all the fun we used to have...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: The fear of not being able to regain what we once had was so overwhelming... Almost like I wasn't valuing these memories as much as I should have...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: In your case, Honami, these happy memories were a key part of wanting to get the band back together, right?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I see...
We all felt the same way.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (It's never easy being away from those you really care about.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (But all the memories you made together can help keep you looking forward...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(And lead you to a brighter future...
Like what happened with us.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I think I know what to do now...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Sorry, everyone! I need to head back to my room and start writing...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
She ran off...
But she has to use her phone to get back...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, I think she realized that once she got to the corridor...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! In elementary school, she'd come charging into our classroom and say...

rows.Speaker: Honami & Shiho
rows.Line: Let's try playing this Miku song together!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
And she'd start blasting it after asking.
Talk about a blast from the past.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: She's been listening to my music for that long...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: She's putting everything she has into this song, so we should make sure we're ready to start working on it once she's done...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Let's start coming up with ideas right now!
